Published online:

Geographic focus:

Temporal focus:
T1. Historical report [YES] — August PPI data, prior BOJ rate decisions referenced
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — BOJ rate hike near-fully priced for next week's meeting (to 1.25%)
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — Further hike to 1.75% expected Q2 2027

Synopsis:
Japan's August wholesale inflation (PPI +7.6% YoY) beat expectations, reinforcing the case for a BOJ rate hike to 1.25% at next week's meeting. Persistent yen weakness and Middle East-driven fuel costs are amplifying import price pressures. The BOJ, already at a 31-year high of 1%, signals strong near-term tightening intent, with markets near-fully pricing the move. Analysts now pull forward the timeline for further hikes to 1.75% into Q2 2027.
